indicators.title: Upfront payment request
indicators.detail: Requests for money before a prize, job, delivery, or service are a strong scam indicator.

indicators.title: OTP / verification-code request
indicators.detail: Never share a one-time code with another person.

indicators.title: Prize / free-money lure
indicators.detail: Unexpected prizes or easy-money claims commonly appear in scams.

recommendations: Do not send money or verification codes.
Verify the person or company using an official channel.
Preserve screenshots, receipts, and other evidence.

preview: You won ₱50,000. Send ₱500 processing fee and OTP now
